title: AI development timeline
caption: Publication-attention curve with the two AI winters shaded and milestone callouts. The curve tracks attention, not capability; the winters are attention crashes, not capability crashes.

title: The D·A·M axis triad
caption: Each vertex is a diagnostic axis and every edge points both ways: relax one bottleneck and it migrates to a neighbor. Our dam-loop.svg distils the loop instead of the triangle.

title: Health vs recall divergence
caption: Runtime health flat while recall slides 95% to 85%: the silent-degradation gap in one margin sketch. Our silent-degradation.svg adds the equation annotation and the monitoring window.

title: Amdahl latency bars
caption: Model time shrinks 3x, pre- and post-processing unchanged: the Amdahl tax on the 30 ms win. Our iron-law-budget.svg generalises the same accounting to the three-term budget.
